full_details: You rehearsed in the morning without the apparel. The clothes are tomorrow. At home between times the loaf was a penny and a full thumb short. At noon John Heminges called from Aldermanbury with the tailor standing by. The old crown from Harry the Sixth is new gilt at four shillings. The Master has saved a looking-glass broke every time. Nick has grown two fingers since Candlemas, and the gown is let down for eighteenpence, with no more cloth. He eats like two, and he sings in the yard of a morning. John heard the thick voice and said to have the tooth out before Thursday, because Gaunt must be heard at the back. You said after Thursday. Asked for Love's Labour's Won, you said when this king is buried. You played Egeon in the afternoon. Across the water the Rose had the New World's Tragedy. You did not cross. At night the jaw was hot to the hand.
one_sentence: Heminges priced a crown at four shillings and a hem at eighteenpence, and the jaw was hot at night.
title: Four shillings, eighteenpence, and the tooth after Thursday
